function: Downlink transmit precoding (TPC) matrix design at a LEO satellite UPA from delayed CSI, maximizing sum rate, directly mapping delayed CSI to the precoder, p. 1, 5-6.
system: LEO satellite with 3x3 UPA (M=9) serving K=2 single-antenna mobile users, TDD, Starlink-like four-layer constellation; 2 GHz and 5 GHz, BW=0.02f, p. 7-8, 11.
method: Deep reinforcement learning: DDPG actor-critic with state augmentation for deterministic observation delay; online training with replay buffer and quantized rate-based reward, p. 5-7, 12.
data_channel: Own MATLAB simulator: Rician LOS plus NLOS UPA channel with Doppler and delay, Starlink-like constellation, users in Lake District UK; 2,000,000 time steps, p. 4, 7, 9.
test_conditions: Average episodic rate during online learning, per case (Td=0, 1, 16; handover threshold; 2 and 5 GHz); handovers occur within the 300 s run, no held-out test, p. 9-11.
baselines: Non-learned: robust non-DL method [31], perfect CSI bound. Learned: CNN channel prediction plus CNN beamforming [6]; DL channel prediction [13] with own DRL mapper, p. 11.
metrics: Average episodic sum rate (bit/s/Hz) and reward, actor and critic losses, per-user rate, handover count, p. 9-11.
complexity: Order O((Td+1)M^2K^2) per time step, from actor and critic dense-layer costs; no runtime or FLOPs given, p. 12.
q1_support: p. 4: "the channel model presented in [13], [14], [15], and [27] can be adopted", an own Rician LOS+NLOS model (Eq. 2-4); p. 9: "We used Matlab for generating the satellite movements" and the CSI; no 3GPP TR 38.811 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 1: "the DRL agent is capable of promptly adapting to the environment when a handover occurs"; p. 12: "Once trained, the model remains adaptive to environmental changes, ensuring robust service even during handovers".
q3_support: p. 11: "we have compared our results with [31], which employs a non-DL approach to mitigate the effects of delayed CSI" and "In [6], the channels were predicted using a convolutional neural network (CNN)" then a second CNN for beamforming; Fig. 6 compares achievable rate.
q4_support: p. 12: "the order of time complexity for our method is scaled by O((Td + 1)M2K2) for each time step", derived from the actor and critic layer costs O(Sin Sout).
q5_support: p. 9: "We used Matlab for generating the satellite movements, selecting the satellite in service via Algorithm 1, and generating the CSI throughout time"; self-generated CSI, no code or data link, no public dataset.
notes: Included, area 6 (satellite downlink precoding under delayed CSI; 6 outranks 3). q2 is a judgement call: evaluation is an online learning curve with no held-out test, and each delay, frequency and threshold case is its own run (p. 9-11, does not count); q2 rests only on the stated adaptation at handovers (abstract, p. 12), reviewer to confirm. For baseline [13] the authors' own DRL maps the predicted channels (p. 11); [6] is the full learned baseline.
